$about: Free and student API-key programs shown in Settings > Cloud models. DATA: ui.mjs sends this with /api/cloud and the page draws one card per program. A program whose `provider` is one of the router's key providers (cloud-setup.mjs KEY_PROVIDERS) gets a paste-your-key field that saves to that provider; `provider: null` means its credits work in another tool and the card says so. Facts were checked against the programs' own pages on `checked`; amounts that vary or are not published are described as such, never guessed. The first four are the programs UMD DIT pointed students to on 2026-11-03.

programs.name: Claude Builder Club
programs.what: Student-run clubs at campuses Anthropic supports. Members have received Claude Pro and API credits (one club lists 6 months of Pro plus $50 of API credits); what you get depends on the campus.
programs.how: Join your school's club, or apply to start one. Credits arrive in your Anthropic Console account: make a key at console.anthropic.com and paste it here.

programs.name: OpenAI Student Collective and Campus Network
programs.what: OpenAI's programs for undergraduate campus leads and student clubs. No API credit amount is published.
programs.how: Apply as a campus lead or through a club. If credits come with it they are on your platform.openai.com account: make a key there and paste it here.

programs.name: GitHub Copilot Student
programs.what: A free Copilot Student plan for verified students through GitHub Education.
programs.how: Verify as a student in GitHub Education. Copilot runs inside editors like VS Code; it does not give an API key Rosalena can use.

programs.name: Kiro for Students
programs.what: A free year of Kiro's paid tier, 1,000 credits a month, at participating universities, checked with your school email.
programs.how: Check whether your university takes part, then verify with your school email. Kiro's credits are used inside Kiro, not through an API key.

programs.name: Gemini API free tier
programs.what: Gemini models with a free, rate-limited tier. No card and no student check.
programs.how: Sign in at Google AI Studio, create an API key and paste it here.

programs.name: OpenRouter free models
programs.what: One key for many providers, including models marked free that cost nothing within a daily request limit.
programs.how: Make an account and a key at openrouter.ai/keys and paste it here.
